description: T10 pre-registered, newly authored multi-sentence translation A/B diagnostic; 30 EN + 30 ID two-line paragraphs; never CP4 gate fixture

design.control: whole paragraph translated in one offline ML Kit call
design.candidate: two newline-delimited source sentences translated independently, joined with a single space
design.order: alternate whole-first and linewise-first by sample index
design.approval: reviewer independently grades both complete final outputs by source paragraph; 60 matched pairs; diagnostic only
design.success: On this NEW data: candidate >=27/30 ACCEPT per direction AND >=3 more ACCEPT than control per direction, zero newly introduced NEGATION_ERROR/NUMBER_OR_NAME_ERROR, candidate p95 end-to-end latency <=2.5x control p95 in each direction; even if all pass, independently verify on a second unseen set before production change.
design.safety: original 60 gate samples, refs, outputs and acceptance labels remain immutable; this dataset is not blind because authored for the experiment
